title: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability…
description: Adobe Experience Manager contains a critical code injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-113579) that allows a low-privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code without user interaction. The vulnerability affects the context of the current user and changes the security scope. It has a very high CVSS score of 9.9, indicating severe impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
